amazon.before: Real food starts with a seed. We have spent years growing and selling organic sprouting seeds, and we watched too many customers fight with the same frustrating kits: mesh lids that rust in weeks, mason jars with shoulders that trap old hulls, and flimsy plastic trays that warp in the dishwasher. So we designed the premium, heavy-duty sprouting kit we always wanted on our own kitchen counters. WHAT'S IN THE BOX: 1 Straight-walled 1-quart glass jar with extra-wide 100mm mouth 1 Rustproof 3-piece lid system (ring, domed mesh strainer, solid storage cover) 1 Rustproof stainless steel stand (set at the ideal 45-degree drain angle) 1 Handcrafted stoneware drainage basin with non-slip silicone feet 1 Quick-start instruction guide HOW IT WORKS: SOAK: Add your seeds, fill the jar with water, and let them sit overnight. RINSE: Drain through the mesh lid and set the jar on the 45-degree stand. Repeat 2 times daily. EAT: Enjoy crisp, fresh sprouts in just 3 to 5 days! BUILT TO BE USED EVERY DAY The innovative domed mesh lid pulls air through the bottom of the jar so your sprouts breathe and grow evenly without spoiling. The straight-walled glass design means there are no inner corners to scrub and no wet hulls left behind. The heavy stoneware basin catches every single drip, keeping your countertop completely dry and beautiful. When your harvest is ready, use the included solid lid to store your fresh sprouts directly in the refrigerator. Every single component is 100% dishwasher safe.
amazon.after: Real food starts with a seed. This kit is how you grow it on your counter. Not picked until you eat it. Store-bought sprouts are often days old when you buy them. Grow your own and they're ready in about five days, with about a minute a day of rinsing. A plain jar works, but it leaves you propping it in a dish rack, wiping drips off the counter, and moving your harvest to another container. This kit handles all three: the stand holds the jar at the right angle to drain, the stoneware basin catches the drips, and the solid cover lets the same jar go straight into the fridge. What's in the Box: - Straight-walled quart glass jar with an extra-wide mouth - Rustproof three-piece lid system: ring, domed mesh strainer, and solid storage cover - Rustproof 316 stainless steel stand that holds the jar at a 45-degree drain angle - Handmade, kiln-fired stoneware drainage basin with non-slip silicone feet - Quick-start guide Seeds are sold separately. How It Works: - Soak: Add your seeds, cover them with water, and soak overnight. - Rinse: Drain through the mesh lid and set the jar on the stand. Rinse and drain morning and evening. - Eat: Your sprouts are ready in about five days. Give them a final rinse, drain them well, and pat them dry. Then swap the mesh for the solid cover and keep them in the fridge for up to a week. Every piece is dishwasher safe. Use it with any sprouting seeds.
